purpose.zh: 把人的最低版本变成十二周、可停止、可移交的最小试点方法。它规定先测什么、由谁复核、什么情况不得进入下一门，不填造现场结果。
purpose.en: Turn the minimum human release into a twelve-week, stoppable and transferable pilot method. It defines what is checked first, who reviews it, and what blocks the next gate without inventing field results.

method_references.use: human-centred activities across the system life cycle
method_references.limit: method reference only; not proof of ISO conformity

method_references.use: risk-based test, evaluation, verification and validation
method_references.limit: voluntary framework; not a Chinese statutory standard

method_references.use: representative journeys, assisted channels, manual checks and independent accessibility audit
method_references.limit: service-design reference; not a local legal or performance claim

method_references.use: institutional foundation, participation, rights, budgeting and monitoring
method_references.limit: international playbook; local authorization and adaptation remain required

decision_rule.zh: 一项关键公共事务只要缺少可用的非 AI 通道、人工接管、申诉、删除证明或独立复核，就不得进入受限试点。
decision_rule.en: A critical public task cannot enter a bounded pilot if a usable non-AI channel, human takeover, appeal, deletion proof, or independent review is missing.

route_attempts.formula: 3 provisional key areas x 4 critical task journeys x 2 dayparts

service_equivalence_cases.formula: 4 public-service tasks x 3 non-AI channels x 2 languages

accessibility_walkthroughs.formula: 3 provisional key areas x 2 dayparts x 2 independent walkthrough roles

failure_and_appeal_drills.formula: 8 registered fail codes from the bounded public-service tabletop

coverage_sampling_plan.sampling_limit_zh: 以上数字是覆盖矩阵的最低计划量，不是人口代表性样本，也不构成招募、排班或现场完成声明。真实参与必须另行授权、知情同意并由无障碍与伦理要求校正。
coverage_sampling_plan.sampling_limit_en: These counts are minimum coverage-matrix quantities, not a statistically representative sample or a claim of recruitment, staffing, or field completion. Real participation requires separate authorization, informed consent, and accessibility and ethics adjustment.

timeline.entry: authorized planning team and declared service scope
timeline.exit_gate: task list, evidence boundary, human routes, and stop owner all recorded
timeline.stop: no accountable planning owner or unresolved data-rights boundary

work: check staffed, telephone, and paper routes
record completion and handoff without identifiers
timeline.exit_gate: every critical task has at least one usable non-AI route
timeline.stop: any critical task lacks a usable non-AI route

work: log critical blockers and repair owners
timeline.exit_gate: no unresolved critical access blocker on a declared task route
timeline.stop: proxy-only review, unavailable assisted channel, or unresolved critical blocker

work: use synthetic or separately authorized minimum data
compare AI suggestion with the recorded human route
timeline.exit_gate: AI remains optional, read-only where possible, and fully reversible
timeline.stop: purpose drift, excess data, automated high-impact action, or missing human takeover

timeline.exit_gate: all critical failures stop safely and every case has appeal and deletion evidence
timeline.stop: unsafe continuation, missing receipt, unanswered appeal, or deletion-proof failure

work: review coverage, failures, unresolved dissent, labour, and resource use
choose hold, revise, bounded pilot, or retire
timeline.entry: complete evidence packet and unresolved-issue list
timeline.exit_gate: independent signed decision with reasons and next evidence
timeline.stop: reviewer conflict, missing dissent record, or unresolved critical defect

gate_thresholds.measure: critical tasks with at least one usable staffed, telephone, or paper route
unresolved critical accessibility blockers on declared task routes
cases where AI refusal reduces basic service access
reviewed cases with accessible receipt and appeal route
records due for deletion with verifiable deletion evidence
independent decision packet with conflicts and dissent disclosed

accountability_slots.duty: declare critical tasks, assisted channels, staffing, and service recovery

accountability_slots.role_zh: 无障碍与包容复核角色
accountability_slots.duty: approve recruitment and walkthrough method; prevent proxy-only review
approve purpose, fields, access, retention, deletion, and incident handling
approve route, facility, emergency, insurance, and stop procedures

accountability_slots.role_zh: 公众与受影响群体联络角色
accountability_slots.duty: record consent, dissent, appeal, response, and non-participation
review evidence and conflicts, then sign hold, revise, bounded-pilot, or retire decision

resource_envelopes.label_zh: 临时服务点与独立审计

action_packages.name_zh: 普通路径与人工服务基线

action_packages.scale: 4 critical tasks in synthetic or separately authorized shadow mode

action_packages.output: stop, receipt, appeal, correction, and deletion evidence

action_packages.scale: portable interventions only; exact quantity after site audit
action_packages.output: installation, access, maintenance, and removal record
signed hold, revise, bounded-pilot, or retire decision

data_and_redress.repository_rule: no real participant or case-level field record enters the public repository
data_and_redress.deletion_proof: authorized steward signs a field-level deletion log; only a non-personal aggregate result and proof identifier may enter the review packet

limits.zh: 本合同和 runner 只证明试点方法内部闭合。十二周、覆盖数量、三档资源和留存上限均为待授权的概念参数，不证明场地、经费、主体、招募、性能、公众接受、许可或官方评分。
limits.en: This contract and runner prove only internal coherence of the pilot method. The twelve weeks, coverage counts, three resource classes, and retention caps are authorization-pending concept parameters; they prove no site, funding, operator, recruitment, performance, public acceptance, permit, or official score.
